items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: He used to live right in the next block from me... So I used to go visit him... Lurie used to treat me swell, and so I got to know him

ctx.x: What sort of relations were there between you and Louis? Did you, was he a personal friend of yours in the old days? Or?

Oh, no. I didn't know Lewis until Chicago, until I met him in Chicago. He used to live right in the next block from me on South Park near 35th Street. And whenever he'd come in, he'd say, Louis is always glad to meet New Orleans musicians or anybody from New Orleans, any kind of people. So I used to go visit him, and by me playing with Little Joe Lindsey, his right-hand man, him and Little Joe Lindsey was raised up together. And Lurie used to treat me swell, and so I got to know him, and he autographed many…
Well, in 1936, Herb, as you said before, you recorded for Deck of Records. That was in Chicago.
